description.narrative: Communications activities are aimed at increasing awareness of Irish Aid’s work among the public in Ireland, as well as increasing understanding of global development issues and how Irish Aid’s policies support and further the implementation of the Sustainable Development Goals. This will be achieved through: 1. Organisation of and participation in public events that attract a wide audience, including the 18-25 age group, increasing knowledge and understanding of Irish Aid and global development issues; 2. Strong Irish Aid online presence, including proactive social media accounts to engage the public in Ireland and other key audiences on the work of Irish Aid; 3. Engagement with Irish and international media outlets on the work of Irish Aid and on global development themes.
Delivery of communications initiatives, outreach events, media engagement and management of Irish Aid website and social media platforms.
